integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. Peak behavior is obtained from explicit tail identities, conditional binomial multiplicities, and a hypergeometric disjointness bound; trough behavior uses explicit maximum-location bounds and a union bound. Finite numerical values are stress checks only.
scientific_limitations: The construction proves nonconvergence of the leader probability for one deliberately lacunary infinite-support product law. It does not determine the exact positive limsup and does not resolve the published infinite-support no-leader conjecture because the constructed sequence has zero liminf.
title: Oscillating leader probabilities from an infinite-support product law
